prompt.text:
Implement parsers for a self-contained packet format in `solution.rs`.

A packet consists of a first line `VERB route`, zero or more attribute lines in `name:value` form, one empty line, and an arbitrary body. Lines and the header/body separator use LF (`\n`) only. The first empty line is always the separator, even if the body contains additional blank lines.

Expose `Verb` with `Read`, `Write`, `Replace`, and `Remove`; `Packet` with public `verb`, `route`, `attributes: Vec<(String, String)>`, and `payload: Vec<u8>` fields; and `TextPacket` with the same fields except `payload: String`. Expose `ParseError` variants `MissingSeparator`, `InvalidHeaderUtf8`, `InvalidStartLine`, `UnknownVerb`, `InvalidAttribute`, and `InvalidBodyUtf8`.

Implement:
- `pub fn parse_packet(input: &[u8]) -> Result<Packet, ParseError>`.
- `pub fn parse_text_packet(input: &[u8]) -> Result<TextPacket, ParseError>`.

The start line must contain exactly two non-empty space-separated fields. Attribute names must be non-empty; values may be empty and are preserved exactly. Preserve attribute order and duplicates. Binary bodies may contain any bytes and may be empty. The text parser must reject a non-UTF-8 body. Parsing must not mutate or retain aliases into the input. Provide a new complete implementation without `main`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
